title: Política
goal: Read about Ecuador's 2000 crisis -- Mahuad's dollarization announcement, the Indigenous takeover of Congress and the brief junta, and Noboa's presidency, under which Ecuador fully adopted the dollar.

items: Describe the protests that Mahuad's announcement unleashed.
Explain what Mahuad announced about Ecuador's currency.
State what happened when Indigenous protesters took Congress.
Explain how Ecuador ended up fully adopting the dollar under Noboa.
Use en cuanto to link two closely timed events.
